metadata.domainName: Internet Number Registry and Routing Trust
metadata.description: Core logical data assets and stores for registry, member, routing security, DNS, measurement, policy, learning, and API operations.

rootGroups.name: People, Accounts, and Access Data
rootGroups.description: Profiles, accounts, credentials, consent, entitlements, and access records used to identify people and govern their access.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Member Organization
assets.description: Member, LIR account, contact, role, legal status, service eligibility, and communication preference data.
assets.accessScope: membership, billing, registry, governance, support, and member portal workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Defines who can use RIPE NCC member services and under what obligations.

interfaces.name: member organization api
interfaces.description: Access interface for Member Organization.

governance.retention: contract lifecycle plus governance and legal retention
governance.sharingPolicy: used for authorized service and governance workflows only

assets.name: Abuse Contact Record
assets.description: Abuse contact information associated with Internet number resources and validation state.
assets.accessScope: public lookup with controlled update and validation workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Supports incident reporting and accountability for resource holders.

interfaces.name: abuse contact api
interfaces.description: Access interface for Abuse Contact Record.

governance.retention: registry lifecycle plus historical audit
governance.sharingPolicy: published according to registry policy and privacy controls

assets.name: Maintainer Access Record
assets.description: Maintainer, role, SSO association, API credential, update authorization, and audit state for RIPE Database object maintenance.
assets.accessScope: authorized maintainer, registry operations, security, and audit workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Protects the integrity of registry objects by ensuring only authorized maintainers can update them.

interfaces.name: maintainer access api
interfaces.description: Authorization interface for object update authority and credential state.

governance.retention: credential lifecycle plus security and legal audit retention
governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to authorized users, registry operations, and security audit roles

assets.name: RIPE Database Object
assets.description: Public and controlled RIPE Database object state for inetnum, inet6num, aut-num, route, route6, organisation, person, role, maintainer, and reverse delegation objects.
assets.accessScope: public Whois, RDAP, REST, web search, bulk data, and authenticated update workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Provides the public coordination surface for Internet number resources, routing policy, contacts, and reverse delegation in the RIPE NCC service region.

interfaces.name: ripe database whois rest and rdap api
interfaces.description: Lookup and update interface for RIPE Database objects.

governance.retention: permanent registry stewardship with object-level history and privacy controls
governance.residency: ripe ncc controlled eu-region operations with public lookup publication
governance.sharingPolicy: public where required for coordination; protected personal and maintainer details controlled by policy and access rules

subGroups.name: Events and Logs
subGroups.description: Append-only events, logs, state changes, and operational traces.

assets.name: API Access Log
assets.description: API key, request, rate limit, latency, error, consumer, and service telemetry for public and authenticated APIs.
assets.accessScope: api operations, security, support, and reliability workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Protects public APIs while preserving stable access for operators and researchers.

interfaces.name: api telemetry event
interfaces.description: Telemetry stream for API access and reliability signals.

governance.retention: security and reliability retention window
governance.sharingPolicy: internal reliability and security use only

rootGroups.name: Commercial and Financial Data
rootGroups.description: Pricing, payment, billing, subscription, revenue, settlement, ledger, and other commercial records.

subGroups.name: Financial Records
subGroups.description: Commercial, payment, billing, ledger, and settlement records.

assets.name: Billing Account
assets.description: Invoice, fee, contribution, payment, charging scheme, redistribution, and account-balance data.
assets.accessScope: finance, membership, member portal, and audit workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Supports the not-for-profit member-funded operating model.

interfaces.name: billing account api
interfaces.description: Access interface for Billing Account.

governance.retention: statutory financial retention
governance.sharingPolicy: member-visible for own invoices and payments; finance-visible for authorized staff

assets.name: Policy Proposal
assets.description: Policy proposal, phase, working group, discussion links, impact assessment, implementation status, and outcome data.
assets.accessScope: public policy process and secretariat support workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Maintains transparency and traceability for community-developed registry policy.

interfaces.name: policy proposal publication
interfaces.description: Access interface for Policy Proposal.

governance.retention: permanent public policy archive
governance.sharingPolicy: public by design with moderated and archived community discussion links

rootGroups.name: Product, Catalog, and Content Data
rootGroups.description: Catalogs, listings, inventory, content, media, products, and merchandising data exposed through customer or operator experiences.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Published Dataset
assets.description: Catalog metadata, downloadable files, API views, terms, provenance, and retention state for public datasets.
assets.accessScope: public dataset consumers and internal publication workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Makes registry and measurement evidence reusable by the Internet community.

interfaces.name: published dataset api
interfaces.description: Access interface for Published Dataset.

governance.retention: dataset-specific retention and public archive rules
governance.sharingPolicy: public with clear terms, privacy filtering, and provenance

rootGroups.name: Operational Workflow and Event Data
rootGroups.description: Orders, bookings, trips, tasks, incidents, service requests, workflow states, and operational events used to run the domain.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Number Resource Record
assets.description: Authoritative registry record for IPv4, IPv6, and AS Number resources, holder relationships, status, and lifecycle metadata.
assets.accessScope: approved registry, member, routing security, and public registry publication workflows
assets.businessMeaning: The authoritative foundation for Internet number resource stewardship.

interfaces.name: number resource record api
interfaces.description: Access interface for Number Resource Record.

governance.retention: permanent registry stewardship with controlled historical audit records
governance.sharingPolicy: public registry publication where policy requires it; restricted member and audit data stays controlled

assets.name: DNS Service Record
assets.description: Operational metadata for K-root, AuthDNS, DNSMON, nodes, health, incidents, and service status.
assets.accessScope: dns operations and controlled public status publication
assets.businessMeaning: Maintains service quality and resilience for critical DNS services.

interfaces.name: dns service api
interfaces.description: Access interface for DNS Service Record.

governance.retention: operational retention with incident and audit history
governance.sharingPolicy: public only for approved service status and transparency views

assets.name: Registry Request
assets.description: Case, evidence, decision, and status data for allocations, assignments, transfers, mergers, and registry checks.
assets.accessScope: registry operations, authorized members, and controlled audit workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Tracks the evidence and decisions behind registry state changes.

interfaces.name: registry request api
interfaces.description: Access interface for Registry Request.

governance.retention: case lifecycle plus legal and audit retention
governance.sharingPolicy: member-visible only for involved parties; audit-visible for authorized operations

rootGroups.name: Risk, Governance, Security, and Compliance Data
rootGroups.description: Risk signals, safety records, audit trails, policies, controls, approvals, and compliance evidence.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Route Origin Authorization
assets.description: ROA object binding prefix, origin ASN, max length, validity interval, and publication state.
assets.accessScope: routing security workflows and public RPKI repository consumers
assets.businessMeaning: Enables BGP origin validation and reduces route hijack risk.

interfaces.name: roa repository publication
interfaces.description: Publication interface for route origin authorizations.

governance.retention: current and historical publication state for operational audit
governance.sharingPolicy: public relying-party publication

assets.name: Routing Authorization Object
assets.description: Emerging RPKI/SIDR authorization object metadata such as ASPA and future routing security artifacts.
assets.accessScope: routing security development, publication, and validation workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Supports future routing security standards beyond ROAs.

interfaces.name: routing authorization object api
interfaces.description: Access interface for emerging routing authorization objects.

governance.retention: standards-driven publication and audit retention
governance.sharingPolicy: public when standardized and published

assets.name: Internet Analysis Output
assets.description: Country reports, maps, derived geolocation outputs, research stories, and analysis provenance.
assets.accessScope: public analysis publication and controlled authoring workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Turns technical evidence into actionable transparency for operators and policy stakeholders.

interfaces.name: analysis publication surface
interfaces.description: Access interface for Internet Analysis Output.

governance.retention: publication lifecycle and public archive
governance.sharingPolicy: public with source provenance and caveats

assets.name: Routing Observation
assets.description: RIS BGP update, RIB, peer, route collector, prefix, ASN, and timing data.
assets.accessScope: public routing data, research, operator analysis, and platform workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Provides neutral evidence about routing behavior and incidents.

interfaces.name: routing observation api
interfaces.description: Access interface for Routing Observation.

governance.retention: long-term public routing research retention
governance.residency: distributed collection with centralized publication stores
governance.sharingPolicy: public route collector data publication

subGroups.name: Events and Logs
subGroups.description: Append-only events, logs, state changes, and operational traces.

assets.name: Audit Log
assets.description: Immutable audit trail for registry, member, billing, routing security, DNS, and API state changes.
assets.accessScope: security, compliance, audit, and incident response workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Provides accountability for changes to critical Internet infrastructure services.

interfaces.name: audit event stream
interfaces.description: Event stream for audited product and registry changes.

governance.retention: security and legal audit retention
governance.residency: ripe ncc controlled operational logging infrastructure
governance.sharingPolicy: restricted to authorized audit, security, and compliance roles

subGroups.name: Analytics and Derived Data
subGroups.description: Aggregated, calculated, scored, predicted, or insight-oriented datasets.

assets.name: Measurement Result
assets.description: RIPE Atlas probe, anchor, measurement, result, credit, and reachability data.
assets.accessScope: public measurement use, research, operations, and authorized platform workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Provides neutral evidence about Internet connectivity and reachability.

interfaces.name: measurement result api
interfaces.description: Access interface for Measurement Result.

governance.retention: measurement retention according to RIPE Atlas terms and operational value
governance.residency: distributed collection with centralized publication stores
governance.sharingPolicy: public by default where terms allow; sensitive host details controlled

rootGroups.name: Architecture, Portfolio, and Planning Data
rootGroups.description: Architecture models, portfolio records, capabilities, roadmaps, standards, and planning evidence.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: Learning Record
assets.description: Course enrollment, progress, completion, exam, voucher, credential, and verification data.
assets.accessScope: learner, training, certification, and credential verification workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Builds measurable operator capability across registry and routing operations.

interfaces.name: learning record api
interfaces.description: Access interface for Learning Record.

governance.retention: credential lifecycle and learner account retention
governance.residency: ripe ncc controlled eu-region operations and approved exam provider processing
governance.sharingPolicy: learner-controlled credential sharing and authorized verification

rootGroups.name: Core Domain Records
rootGroups.description: Primary domain records that do not fit a more specialized data group.

subGroups.name: Core Records
subGroups.description: Durable domain entities and business objects.

assets.name: RPKI Certificate
assets.description: Resource certificate, manifest, CRL, publication, and repository state for hosted RPKI.
assets.accessScope: routing security services and public relying-party publication
assets.businessMeaning: Provides cryptographic proof that resources are registered by the RIR.

interfaces.name: rpki repository
interfaces.description: Publication interface for RPKI certificates and signed objects.

governance.retention: per certification practice statement and cryptographic audit requirements
governance.residency: distributed repository publication with controlled key operations
governance.sharingPolicy: public relying-party publication; private keys remain tightly controlled

assets.name: Reverse DNS Delegation
assets.description: Reverse DNS zone delegation, nameserver, DNSSEC, zone-check, and publication state.
assets.accessScope: member DNS management and public DNS publication workflows
assets.businessMeaning: Connects address resources to trusted reverse DNS authority.

interfaces.name: reverse dns delegation api
interfaces.description: Access interface for Reverse DNS Delegation.

governance.retention: current and historical DNS publication audit
governance.sharingPolicy: public DNS publication and controlled member update

stores.name: Registry Database
stores.description: Primary operational database for Internet number resource records and public registry publication state.

stores.name: RIPE Database Store
stores.description: Authoritative object store for RIPE Database, RIPE IRR, reverse delegation, Whois, REST, and RDAP publication state.

stores.name: Maintainer and Access Control Store
stores.description: Restricted store for maintainer authority, SSO associations, API credentials, object update permissions, and authorization audit state.

stores.name: Registry Case Store
stores.description: Case store for allocation, transfer, merger, registry review, and evidence workflows.

stores.name: Member Database
stores.description: Primary store for member organizations, LIR accounts, contacts, roles, and eligibility state.

stores.name: Billing Database
stores.description: Primary store for billing accounts, invoices, payment status, and fee calculations.

stores.name: RPKI Repository
stores.description: Certificate and signed-object repository for RPKI and routing authorization publication.

stores.name: DNS Operations Store
stores.description: Operational store for reverse DNS, AuthDNS, DNSMON, and K-root service metadata.

stores.name: Measurement Data Lake
stores.description: Analytical store for RIPE Atlas probe, anchor, measurement, and result data.

stores.name: Routing Data Lake
stores.description: Analytical store for RIS route collector BGP observations.

stores.name: Public Data Catalog
stores.description: Public dataset catalog, metadata store, and dataset publication surface.

stores.name: Analysis Publication Store
stores.description: Store for country reports, maps, derived analysis outputs, and provenance.

stores.name: Policy Process Store
stores.description: Store for policy proposals, status, implementation notes, and governance publication metadata.

stores.name: Learning and Credential Store
stores.description: Store for academy progress, exam, voucher, and credential records.

stores.name: API Telemetry Store
stores.description: Operational telemetry for public and authenticated API access.

stores.name: Audit Log Stream
stores.description: Immutable event stream for audited changes across critical domain services.
